refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: [psi, x] = shanwavf(lb, ub, n, fb, fc)

listitem.para: Interval endpoints (real-valued scalars). Specifies the range [lb, ub] where the wavelet is evaluated. Must satisfy lb ≤ ub.
Number of regularly spaced points in the interval [lb, ub] (positive integer).
Time-decay parameter of the wavelet (bandwidth in the frequency domain). Must be a positive scalar.
Center frequency of the complex Shannon wavelet. Must be a positive scalar.
Complex Shannon wavelet evaluated on the n-point regular grid `x` in the interval [lb, ub]. Returned as a 1-by-n vector.
Grid where the complex Shannon wavelet is evaluated. Returned as a 1-by-n vector. The sample points are evenly distributed between lb and ub.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `shanwavf` function computes the Complex Shannon wavelet on a regular grid in the interval [lb, ub]. The wavelet is defined by the expression: psi(x) = fb^(1/2) * sinc(fb * x) * exp(2 * %i * %pi * fc * x) where `sinc(x) = sin(%pi * x) / (%pi * x)`.

refsection.title: Examples
refsection.programlisting: // Compute the Complex Shannon wavelet: [psi, x] = shanwavf(2, 8, 3, 1, 6)
